summary:
可口可樂最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現強韌的定價能力與穩健的全球需求。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為 0.97 美元，優於市場預期的 0.93 美元。
• 季度營收達到 133.8 億美元，年增率為 6.74%。
• 受惠於有效的定價策略與產品組合優化，毛利率維持穩健。
• 核心非氣泡飲料與新興市場展現良好的成長動能。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報傳遞出防禦型股票強大的抗震能力，營收與獲利超預期有助於支撐中短期股價表現。追蹤指標應關注全球銷量成長與外匯逆風的實際影響。

需留意：全球匯率波動持續對海外營收換算造成壓力。；原物料成本若出現反彈可能壓縮利潤空間。；高通膨環境下消費者對部分高價品項的可負擔性面臨挑戰。

summary_en:
Coca-Cola reported better-than-expected Q2 EPS and revenue, demonstrating resilient pricing power and steady global demand.
• EPS of $0.97 outperformed the estimated $0.93.
• Quarterly revenue reached $13.38B, representing a 6.74% YoY growth.
• Gross margins remained robust supported by effective pricing and product mix optimization.
• Core non-sparkling beverages and emerging markets demonstrated solid growth momentum.

Watch：Global currency volatility continues to pressure international revenue conversion.; Potential rebounds in raw material costs could compress profit margins.; Affordability challenges for premium items amid persistent inflationary pressures.
